dispute.claim_text: Same route every time, never above 40. Today I had my own navigation on and I saw him take the longer way twice. He underestimated modern technology. I've already reported this to the authorities and I'm just waiting. Taxis ripping people off is the worst.

counterparty_statement.text: I took the BKE-PIE route because the CTE had a queue at the Braddell exit. It's a normal route. Her 'usual price' depends on time of day; today was peak.
